objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, versioned, archived, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document name including type abbreviation, consecutive number, and title by default.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each document type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version metadata that can be printed in the document and is maintained through versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document status, including released, editing, out of force, or workflow status.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document with TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity count starts after release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which the document must be reviewed for validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version referenced for translation visibility and release condition.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used for templates, abbreviation, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the document type.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation used in document names.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period definable for each document type; 3 years in DHC VISION standard.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration definable for each document type; 10 years in DHC VISION standard.

objs.name: document_level
objs.description: Level in the document pyramid used to differentiate documents for structuring and evaluation.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type documenting regulations and instructions, locally defined regulations, or business-process-related regulations.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details, and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting special work steps in sub-processes and detailed steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_document
objs.description: New document generated based on standard MS Office formats.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained for document properties and grouped into categories.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose in properties editing.

objs.name: control_release_category
objs.description: Document property category used for authorization assignment and workflow participant allocation.

objs.name: master_data_category
objs.description: Example category for maintainable document metadata.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Reference maintained through document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data attribute maintained to link documents to IT applications.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained via document properties for document linking or validity.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained via document properties for document linking or validity.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process object to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit object to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk object to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data object to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

attributes.name: released
attributes.description: Property switch for direct release and publication.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document added to a document and automatically released with the release of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Own versioning of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status passed through with the release process of the main document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person or user participating in authoring, reviewing, releasing, reading, translating, acknowledging, or administration.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorization assignment, distribution, dashboards, and role membership.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role for users who can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role or assigned person responsible for document authorship and first workflow signature.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Assigned person with personal change rights and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Assigned person who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Assigned person responsible for the document and its content and deciding distribution to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents after other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to user groups or persons for documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning User Groups or persons for automatic information or acknowledgement.

objs.name: distribution_by_e_mail
objs.description: Distribution type where assigned users and users of assigned User Groups are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

objs.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
objs.description: Distribution type where assigned persons and users of assigned User Groups are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by a recipient that acknowledgement of a released document version has been completed.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing flow for approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, or translation.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and communicated by e-mail notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete approval tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: System message informing involved users of workflow tasks, status, releases, validity extension, change proposals, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: released_version
objs.description: Released version of a document for which signatures are documented and which may be published.

objs.name: editing_version
objs.description: New version created in editing status when a released document is changed or revised.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: completed
attributes.description: State after editing is documented, after which the proposal is no longer displayed in the document.

objs.name: cockpit
objs.description: Area for a document where Change proposals are created and managed and Distribution lists are maintained.

objs.name: change_proposals_folder
objs.description: Folder in the document cockpit where Change proposals are created and managed.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected released document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for revalidating invalidated documents and processed by workflow.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document may be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific view filled using distribution groups and showing relevant documents or evaluations.

objs.name: document_list_dashboard
objs.description: Reader dashboard listing all documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language-dependent display version of a released document.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Assignment of User Groups or persons to inform or request acknowledgement for a document release.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attachment of a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more defined document templates when creating new document objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for external files or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_office_document
evts.description: Generate a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata and document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version of the document on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translation participants in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add an object of type Additional info to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish Additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify Additional information without affecting the main document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the 3-step approval process after document creation, property maintenance, content maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete review tasks for the document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes the release task and the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Inform involved users about workflow tasks, status, releases, pending validity extension, change proposal creation or editing, or acknowledgement.

evts.name: document_electronic_signature
evts.description: Document the signatures of individual workflow participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, causing a new editing version to be created.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new version in editing status from a released document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity for a document, delete the request, and update valid until.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension when a revised document version is released or when suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for AKS or out of force for a selected document.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for processing the request for override after attachment of the request.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document and its attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke authorizations at user group and person level except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new version of the document and restoring authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign User Groups or persons to a document's Distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request assigned persons and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document workflow task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team when all persons maintained in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: populate_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards using distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports or searches using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the system into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_document_addition
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to describe a local change or extension and reference the original document.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of a corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Policy is an example document type at level 1.
Guideline is an example document type at level 2.
Procedural Instruction is an example document type at level 3.
Work Instruction is an example document type at level 4.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to each document and are associated with the main document.
References can be maintained for a document to enable linking.
IT applications can be maintained via document properties to link documents.
Relevant companies can be maintained via document properties.
Areas of validity can be maintained via document properties.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with Master data.
Document properties include maintained metadata.
Attributes and metadata are grouped in categories.
Assignment of authorizations and participants is carried out via property editing in the Control release category.
Master data category is an example category for a document.
Documents are controlled by assigning authorizations.
Read and change rights can be assigned to a group of users/persons for each document.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, and translation.
A document has a registered author in the Author field.
Additional personal change rights are assigned via the Co-authors attribute.
Reviewers maintained in attributes are assigned for review.
Releasers maintained in attributes are assigned for release.
Reader authorizations are assigned via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.
Users are assigned to User Groups.
Users assigned to Authors User Groups are offered in author or co-author selection lists.
Users assigned to Reviewer User Groups are offered in the reviewer selection list.
Users assigned to releaser User Group are offered in the releaser selection list.
A translator can translate released content into another language.
Reader - Document Management is implemented as a standard User Group for readers.
Users in the Archive group retain read access to archived documents.
Only the Business Admin group is permitted to create requests for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning User Groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Distribution by e-mail is one type of Distribution in the system.
Distribution for acknowledgement is one type of Distribution in the system.
Acknowledgements are documented for documents and current versions.
Workflow participants complete workflow tasks.
Workflow tasks are assigned to involved users.
The system informs users of workflow tasks by e-mail notifications.
Approval workflow tasks are completed with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented for each released version.
A document can have a released version.
Changes to released documents result in a new editing version.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
Change proposals are created and managed in the Change proposals folder.
The Change proposals folder is in the cockpit for a document.
Change proposals and distribution lists are managed in the Cockpit for a document.
The request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override can be created for a selected document.
A document is selected for reactivation in a request for reactivation.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.
Distribution groups in the distribution list fill user and role-specific dashboards.
All documents relevant to the user are listed in the Document list dashboard.
Role-specific evaluation reports and searches are available for documents in the system.
Translation allows language-dependent display of released documents.
A translator can translate released content into another language.
Distribution is maintained by assigning User Groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Distribution lists are maintained for each document for distribution.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats from an object cover.
